baseline.name: Eager rectangle writes
baseline.approach: Rewrite every affected cell on update, then answer queries directly from the matrix.
baseline.time: O(A) per update of area A; O(1) query
baseline.space: Matrix storage; optional copy if preserving input

archived.name: Deferred update history
archived.time: O(1) append update; O(u) worst-case query after u updates
archived.space: Fixed 500-update history plus borrowed original matrix

why: The archive shifts work from updates to queries by searching newest assignments instead of rewriting cells.
quantitative_comparison: An update replaces A cell assignments with one five-field history append, but a query may inspect u rectangles rather than one matrix cell. Whether it is better depends on areas and the update/query mix; no universal winner is established.
tradeoffs: Query-heavy workloads can be worse. The original matrix must remain alive/unchanged; the history capacity, bounds and allocations are trusted.
evidence_basis: Static per-operation work model with both sides of the update/query trade-off; no workload benchmark.
